# Commander V test project

Select `hello.js` and `components`, right-click, and choose **Commander V**.
Paste into a new untitled editor to inspect the tree and file contents.

Then edit `hello.js`, enable **Commander V: Read From Editor**, leave the edit
unsaved, and run **Reuse last Commander V Selection** from the command palette.
The clipboard should include your unsaved text, even with another tab active.
